title: Tiny, cute wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watch band top -->
  <rect x="38" y="8" width="24" height="28" rx="6" fill="#5a7d9a" stroke="#8fb3cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- watch band bottom -->
  <rect x="38" y="64" width="24" height="28" rx="6" fill="#5a7d9a" stroke="#8fb3cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- buckle top -->
  <rect x="42" y="4" width="16" height="8" rx="3" fill="#c0c8d0" stroke="#e0e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- buckle bottom -->
  <rect x="42" y="88" width="16" height="8" rx="3" fill="#c0c8d0" stroke="#e0e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="#e8a33d" stroke="#f5d08a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- watch face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="#1a3a5c" stroke="#3a6a9c" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="33" r="2" fill="#7ddf7d"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="67" r="2" fill="#7ddf7d"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="50" r="2" fill="#7ddf7d"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="50" r="2" fill="#7ddf7d"/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x="48" y="36" width="4" height="15" rx="2" fill="#7ddf7d"/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x="49" y="30" width="3" height="22" rx="1.5" fill="#ffdf6b"/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="3" fill="#ff8a8a"/>
  <!-- cute eyes on dial -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 59 Q50 64 56 59" fill="none" stroke="#a0e8ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- strap links detail -->
  <line x1="40" y1="14" x2="60" y2="14" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="22" x2="60" y2="22" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="30" x2="60" y2="30" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="70" x2="60" y2="70" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="78" x2="60" y2="78" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="86" x2="60" y2="86" stroke="#7a9ab8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>
